title: Slime Warrior Sokoban
description:
FOR DOG LOVERS

RECOMMENDED FOR YOU

Об игреThe Gameplay
Let's get some slimes!

Limited movement.

Sometimes the door will need keys.

Think carefully about every step until you reach the door.

Features:
♦ 3 Worlds with unique environments
♦ 40 hand-craft levels
♦ Difficulty progression for a growing challenge over the levels
♦ Beautiful pixel art
♦ A lot of slimes to slay!
description_short: You are the Warrior on a quest to find and defeat the Slime Gladiator. With a limited movement, you need to think carefully about every step until you reach the door. Use your special power, push boxes, find keys, beware of traps, and slay every slime that get in your way!
